enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed with eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket down. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting ready for work
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Scrub body. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Brush teeth. Apply deodorant.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread, butter. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Scramble eggs. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster. Spread butter on toast. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Put coffee in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Stir coffee. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out front door. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Drive. Stop at red light. Turn left. Park car. Turn off engine. Get out. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and clinical assessments
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward. Pick up patient chart. Review patient history. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Attend briefing. Consult with doctor.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay cashier. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Wipe mouth. Clear tray. Throw away trash. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing patient care shift, charting and handing over clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Return to ward. Check patient list. Visit patient 1. Administer meds. Update chart. Visit patient 2. Perform assessment. Update chart. Attend meeting. Discuss with colleagues. Prepare handover notes. Handover to next shift.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Drive. Stop at red light. Turn right. Park car at home. Turn off engine. Get out. Lock car. Walk to front door. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Undress. Put clothes in hamper. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Scrub body. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Put on clean clothes. Hang towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Rinse dishes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Select channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust sitting position. Lean back. Cross legs. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal admin and reading health care articles
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to computer. Sit on chair. Turn on monitor. Turn on computer. Type password. Open browser. Check email. Respond to email. Open bank website. Pay bills. Read article. Take notes. Close browser. Turn off computer. Turn off monitor. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and evening personal hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pat dry. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting the room for sleep and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Fold clothes. Put clothes in drawer. Set alarm on phone. Plug in phone. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull covers over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
